modules.module_title: Create a nurturing environment that promotes holistic development and fosters lifelong learning in children

pcs.pc_description: Comprehend the types of Childcare Institutions
Comprehend the role of the essential components of an effective childcare institution, including the physical setup, safety measures, team members
Recognize the importance of being sensitive to children's developmental needs and committed to their welfare, ensuring the provision of a nurturing and safe environment.
Develop skills to impart the key age-specific roles and responsibilities of a childcare worker prioritizing the holistic development and well-being of children

Assist in arranging furniture, labelling activity zones, implementing safety measures, ensuring proper ventilation, organizing storage, and maintaining designated spaces for sleeping, breastfeeding, and hygiene to create a safe, organized, and child-friendly environment
Assist in ensuring that the physical environment is safe, including child-proofing spaces and well-maintained equipment
Contribute to helping with activities, supervising children, and assisting in running childcare institutions smoothly
Comprehend and follow the verbal and written instructions to help carry out the responsibilities as directed by the seniors, including preparing for activities and maintaining cleanliness

modules.module_title: Perform assisted daily living activities as per age of child

pcs.pc_description: Demonstrate the correct techniques of massage, bathing, grooming, dressing-up, cleaning, and elimination care as per age-wise specifications
Assist the child in Toilet training and schedule regular toilet breaks to help them develop consistent habits
Maintain self-Hygiene before, during and after the caregiving activity
Organize materials and set up the work area before, during and after the caregiving activity
Provide hair care, nail care, oral care, umbilical cord and eye care to the child as per standard protocols
Demonstrate the process of providing cleaning, Diaper Changing and disposal of soiled diapers
Encourage children to perform activities like Hand Hygiene, washing and cleaning of private parts, dress up etc. independently
Incorporate cultural sensitivity, regional variations, linguistic and socioeconomic diversity in caregiving practices
Follow the protocols of undressing, dressing- up and changing clothing of child as per the season, occasion and activity
Follow safe & unsafe touch guidelines while providing care

modules.module_title: Monitor and assure sound sleep of the child

pcs.pc_description: Follow the standard procedure of putting child on asleep and waking him up
Implement the various child comfort techniques (eg: soothing, secure attachment, sleep routines) to assure sound and restful sleep environment
Ensure child is in comfortable clothes during sleep
Check for diaper and nappy during sleep
Check for any distraction, sound, light or any noise during the sleep
Observe and record the sleeping duration and pattern
Report to parents or higher authority if any irregularities being observed during sleep

modules.module_title: Maintain daily schedule of child

pcs.pc_description: Collect information about the daily schedule and routine of the child from the parents/seniors
Ensure that the child follows the planned schedule for the day as per age-wise specifications
Ensure that the area around the child is always clean, hygienic and hazard free
Keep a check on regular cleaning of the centre and washrooms with disinfectants like phenol to maintain a hygienic environment
Ensure regular sanitizing of toys to prevent the spread of germs
Keep a check on daily duties related to childcare like cleaning, laundry and housekeeping
Restock the material like clothes, diapers, wipes, bed sheets, linen, and washcloths etc. as and when required
perform bed-making before and after every use by child
Carry out recreational activities like puzzles, blocks, games, art, craft, singing, dancing, and storytelling to keep children engaged and active
Monitor or observe child’s play activity and report to their parents or higher authority
Accompany the child during transportation from van/car/bus to centre or settings and from setting to back to the van or car or bus
Keep a track of daily schedule of children recording the completed activities, any variations, and special observations
Follow reporting mechanism of any alarming signs, handing-over of duties and reporting to seniors

pcs.pc_description: perform hand hygiene before, during and after meal preparation
maintain personal hygiene and grooming while cooking or preparing a meal
aggregate ingredients required for the preparation of a meal as per meal plan after checking food items or ingredients for freshness and expiry
measure the right quantity of raw food or ingredients required to prepare the meal
organize kitchen, surroundings, food items and utensils required for cooking
check if the utensils are clean, sterile, and dry before meal preparation
demonstrate the techniques of washing, peeling, chopping, cutting, grinding etc.

modules.module_title: Preparing meals tailored to nutritional needs

pcs.pc_description: Develop awareness of and sensitivity to cultural differences in dietary practices and needs
prepare meal like formula milk, solids, semi solids as per meal plan in order to provide balanced meals to children in the centre to promote good health
demonstrate various methods of meal preparation like dry heating, roasting, boiling, steaming etc. to provide innovative, nutritious, economical and child friendly dishes as per the meal menu
Follow the healthy, safe and hygienic food preparation, storage, serving and discard practices in the center
check for consistency, temperature, flavor, quantity etc as per the requirement
Comprehend breastfeeding initiation and promotion techniques
Follow complementary and bottle-feeding guidelines and techniques
Arrange ingredients for the meal preparation according to the modified meal plan for age and needs for nutritional disorders (malnutrition, obesity or nutritional deficiencies)
Manage stocks and availability of items.

modules.module_title: Demonstrate the responsive feeding techniques for the children

pcs.pc_description: Identify the need for assistance in feeding children of different ages
sterilize the bottles and other feeding equipment appropriately
Maintain hygiene while assisting the child in feeding
Use a clean sheet on the floor for serving food, arrange necessary items on a stool, and have wet towels, gauze, and tubs ready for cleaning and disposal
Arrange children in a semicircle, assist those needing help, and serve food on individual plates with spoons.
Serve food in prescribed portions, avoid leftovers, ensure food is not too hot, and use only intact utensils with enough spoons for all children.
Feed children attentively based on their needs, engage with them during meals, encourage self-feeding, and feed those who wake up later.
Ensure the child has ingested the food properly and make the infant burp after the feed, if required
Identify signs of discomfort while feeding the child
Report an event of choking to higher authority
Attend to the post feed requirements of children and dining area
Record the intake of children
Inculcate healthy eating habits / behaviour, self-feeding attitude and value of respect for food in children

modules.module_title: Perform a wide range of activities to support physical development that are appropriate to the age needs and ability of the children

pcs.pc_description: pay careful attention to children observing how they move around the setting and coordinate their movements, make use of space and large equipment, manipulate and use small equipment
observe if children developed the gross motor skills of children like lifting ones head, rolling over, sitting up, balancing, crawling and walking etc.
observe if children developed the fine motor skills of children like lifting ability to manipulate small objects, transfer objects from hand to hand, and various hand eye coordination task etc
observe if children developed the precise motor skills of children like pincer grasp to pick up small objects, cutting, coloring, writing, threading beads etc
encourage children to perform in a wide range of activities supporting physical development that are appropriate to the age needs and ability of the children

organize safe and appropriate materials and available space for carrying out activities effectively in which children use their gross and fine motor muscles or body parts for age-appropriate physical development

provide children adequate time and opportunity to practice activities like balancing while walking, running, climbing, skipping, catching, throwing, jumping, tearing, pasting, coloring, clay modelling, buttoning etc.
monitor and keep an eye on children, never to be left unattended
observe, share and support in documenting milestones like sitting, crawling, and grasping objects to support motor skills.
identify and report any deviations in the physical growth of a child as per the developmental milestones

modules.module_title: Perform various activities to support cognitive and creative development of a child

pcs.pc_description: pay careful attention to children observing how they explore the physical, social and natural environment by using play and imagination, concentrating on activities, memorizing things, observing surroundings, manipulating objects, asking questions, making predictions, showing their creativity and developing generalizations.
observe if children developed the basic cognitive skills of children including sense of sight, hearing, touch, taste and smell.
observe if children developed the basic mental skills of children related to comparing, classification, observation, reasoning, critical thinking, problem solving, sequencing.

observe if children developed various concepts of predicting patterns and making estimations in color, size, shape, pre number and number concepts, time and operations like space, quantity, measurement, and data handling
observe if children developed appropriate knowledge of relationship between people, places and regions
observe if children could differentiate between events that happen in past, present and the future.
encourage children to perform in a wide range of activities supporting cognitive and creative development that are appropriate to the age needs and ability of the children

organize safe and appropriate materials and available space for carrying out activities effectively in which children use their senses, mental abilities, basic and creative skills for age-appropriate cognitive development.

• provide children adequate time and opportunity to practice activities for :- • a. sensory development like (look and identify, listen and identify, touch board, identification of different taste and smell) • b. mental skills like (puzzles, number game, odd one out, picture card classification, and word building game etc) • c. concept development skills like (counting, matching, identification, naming and classification of color, shapes, numbers.) • d. creative and aesthetic development through creative
observe, share and support in document milestones like creative, cognitive, and problem-solving skills to support cognitive growth.
identify and report any deviations in the cognitive or creative growth of a child as per the developmental milestones

modules.module_title: Perform various activities to support communication and language development of a child

pcs.pc_description: • pay careful attention to children observing how they: • • communicate verbally and non verbally with adults and each others. • • use language including speaking, listening, reading, and writing. • • respond and participate in language activities
identify the listening skills of children through sound discrimination
identify the speaking skills of children through free conversation and creative expression
identify reading skills of children through sound and visual discrimination
identify writing skills of children by observing fine muscle coordination and eye and hand coordination
encourage children to perform in a wide range of activities supporting communication and language development that are appropriate to the age needs and ability of the children

organize safe and appropriate material and available space for carrying out activities effectively in which children learn language through imitating others, repetition, encouragement, and opportunities to listen and speak.

• provide children adequate time and opportunity to acquire proper language skills by giving : • a. healthy stimulation • b. opportunity for speaking and listening to good quality conversation from others • c. freedom to play and interact with environment through nature walk

observe, share and support in identifying if children are school ready with appropriate listening and speaking skills; reading and writing skills; and skills related to sound discrimination, visual discrimination, audio and visual association
identify and report any deviations in the communication or language development of a child as per the developmental milestones

modules.module_title: Perform various activities to support socio emotional and moral development of a child

pcs.pc_description: pay careful attention to qualities, habits, behavior pattern, social interactions and emotional expression of children.
Support children’s positive socio emotional development according to the procedures of the setting, the child’s age, needs and abilities
Encourage children’s self-confidence, self- esteem, participation, and decision-making skills by giving love, praise, encouragement and equal opportunities.
Adopt the different ways of inculcating socio emotional skills and good habits, behavior in children like observation, imitation, repetition, play activities in enjoyable manner etc
Avoid using jargon, abusive language, aggression, punishment and other negative attitude while developing discipline, values and good attitude in children
Support children in expressing feelings and emotions during storytelling, music therapy, and art therapy
Help children in maintaining Mindfulness and Self-Regulation during simple breathing exercise, muscle relaxation, etc
observe if children developed sense of self- concept; self control; self awareness, life skills/ self help skills, independence and autonomy
observe if children developed awareness of abilities and preferences, appreciation towards similarities and differences in people and awareness of behaviour and its actions
observe if children developed habit formation, increased attention span, engagement and persistence in daily activities
identify interpersonal skills of children with respect to peers, family, teachers and community
observe if children developed skills of cooperation; compassion; social relationships; group interaction; social behaviour; expressing feelings, accepting others feelings

observe if children can adapt and control on emotions like shame, guilt, embarrassment, early pride, love, affection, crying, happiness, anger, temper tantrums, sadness, fear, joy, aggression; Temperament and children’s behaviour
identify and report any deviations in the socio- emotional or moral development of a child as per the developmental milestones

modules.module_title: Identify signs and symptoms of 4 D’s: Defects at birth, diseases, deficiencies, and development delays

pcs.pc_description: Identify red flags of 4 D’s (Defects, Deficiencies, Diseases, Developmental Delays, disabilities and impairments)
Observe and analyze children's behavior, interactions, behavioral patterns and developmental milestones
Demonstrate use of various simple screening tools and techniques for early detection of these conditions
Document and report observations and findings accurately and systematically

modules.module_title: Handling, caring, supporting children with developmental delays and special needs

pcs.pc_description: assist in making an adpative environment for children with special needs
pay individualised attention to children with special needs
provide emotional support to children with special needs
assist children with special needs while performing practical activities

modules.module_title: Conducting activities and organizing materials as per TLM (Teaching Learning Materials)

pcs.pc_description: assist in segregating different learning or activities corners in the setting where children can explore, make things, experiment and pursue their own interest
organize a range of materials, equipment and props in activity area to support creativity following the children's interests and setting requirements
check that the environment is appropriate for the age and developmental stage of the children
encourage children to find, use, and return materials independently

use different types of methodologies to provide an interesting, stimulating and exciting environment for children like play, visual and tactile displays, exercise, role play, use of sounds, color, music and other
help children while using indoor and outdoor areas and ICT as part of their exploration and investigation
ensure the children can see and easily move through all the areas of the settings
ensure that the activity area is hygienic, safe, secure, obstacle and hazard free
inculcate safety and hygienic habits in the child while performing activities
display children’s work or activity in ways that encourage them and support their self-esteem
safely observe and supervise children’s activity without over and under protecting them

modules.module_title: Adapting with customized TLM as per special needs of children

pcs.pc_description: support seniors during implementation of the customized schedule for the differently abled children
support other children in practicing inclusion
support seniors in customizing learning environment and areas as per identified special needs of children

modules.module_title: Maintain records related to child developmental growth in a development chart or diary or MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card of the child.

pcs.pc_description: Record daily activities of children including meals taken, nap period, medicines given (if any), washroom visits (in case of infants and toddlers), sudden illness, accident/injury etc.
Record findings accurately in a development chart or diary or MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card of the child
maintain confidentiality of documents

modules.module_title: Observe and report the alarming signs related to developmental growth as per organizational policies and procedures

pcs.pc_description: identify any deviation in the physical/mental/social/emotional/communication and language developmental growth of children as per the developmental milestone
identify any signs and symptoms during daily living activities
report your findings to the parents or higher authority based on the requirements of your settings

modules.module_title: Maintain personal, children, environmental hygiene and sanitation

pcs.pc_description: Follow general and specific etiquettes of grooming, behaviour and habits on duty.
Follow organizational hygiene and sanitation guidelines of center and report breaches/gaps if any
Get yourself vaccinated against common infectious diseases.
Get your medical health checkups periodically and as and when required
Follow personal and environmental hygiene practices in a childcare centre
maintain a clean, ventilated, hygienic and safe environment within the center
Check and report about safety of food and drinking water facilities to appropriate authorities
Follow basic personal and workplace hygiene practices such as washing hands, using alcohol- based hand sanitizers, examining office supplies/deliveries and their sanitization, etc.
Follow maximal social distancing practices while carrying out everyday tasks
Demonstrate the process of donning, doffing, and discarding PPE
Keep indoor and outdoor work spaces sanitized regularly and properly
Follow the appropriate process of categorization, disposal, transportation, and treatment of waste in the center
Check if parents are sending clean and hygienic children to the center and report about the same
Follow protocols to support cleaning and dressing children as per hygienic standards
Use separate sheets for food, play, and rest areas and regularly sanitize toys and other shared items to prevent the spread of germs
maintain children's personal hygiene throughout the day including managing soiled clothes and ensuring proper hygiene after toilet use to prevent infections and illnesses
Utilize teaching aids to promote hygienic practices amongst children
Identify and report symptoms and incidents to the concerned authorities

modules.module_title: Identify the infectious and other ailments in children and report it timely

pcs.pc_description: Follow prescribed rules and guidelines during any communicable diseases and other ailments.
Follow isolation practice for infected children to reduce spread of infection respiratory, diarrhoeal, skin infection, parasitic infestation such as lice etc.
Identify, record, and report incidents of infectious diseases, health issues, allergy episodes, etc. diligently

modules.module_title: Orient towards health, wellness and immunization domains

pcs.pc_description: Practice preventive measures as given in center health policy to prevent bacterial and viral infections such as by maintaining a clean environment and proper food storage
Measure anthropometric indicators for growth monitoring accurately through available trackers such as Poshan Tracker
Provide opportunities for physical movements and activities like dance, yoga, athletics, etc. to staff and children

Identify basic mental health issues including stress, anxiety, fear, phobia, significant and persistent changes in mood, such as constant sadness, extreme irritability, or excessive mood swings, along with behavioral changes like increased tantrums, defiance, or social withdrawal, etc.
Keep a track of immunization status of the children and report about the same to higher authorities

Create a happy experience for children through adult - child-child mindful interactions, age- appropriate activities, welcoming and comfortable environment for strengthening mental, spiritual and emotional health of children.

modules.module_title: Provide effective care for sick children

pcs.pc_description: Observe and report sickness or illness of child to higher authority or parents at the earliest
Escort and accompany the children in the sick room/area in the childcare set-up to handle sick children or to seek medical help
Provide the right dose of medicines to the baby or toddler on time, only when instructed by parents or higher authorities
Escort and accompany children during their regular health checkups
Follow do’s and don’ts while handling sick children in center

modules.module_title: Child protection, safety, Abuse, First Aid and Emergency Response

pcs.pc_description: Keep indoor and outdoor environment safe for children in a childcare centre
keep a check on working condition of safety equipment and report any defaults promptly
Handle emergencies safely and appropriately
Maintain safe and secure environments by following child-proofing measures and health regulations, while also keeping accurate records for each child
follow the prevention measures of child abuse and neglect
monitor the child at all times and do not leave the baby unattended
Deal with all incidents of child neglect and abuse appropriately, keeping it well-recorded and reported to parents.
Identify the signs of abuse and harassment, accident, injury, pain, and other symptoms of illness and address the same with appropriate authorities
protect and make the child aware of the threats from interaction with undesirable persons to avoid possible harassment, abuse and abduction
Identify the nature of the emergency and assess the child’s condition
Stay calm and follow first aid procedures
Demonstrate correct technique of providing CPR
Contact emergency services or the child’s parents, if necessary
Organize spaces, furniture and materials keeping safety of children.
Apply disaster management techniques to deal with institutional emergencies
follow fire safety management procedure as and when required
Document the incident and first aid provided for record-keeping
Follow child protection policies and safety protocols of center
cooperate during background screening by police for criminal background checks, child abuse clearances and reference interviews
